## Human metadata still required

These cannot be inferred safely from the scientific repository and must be
filled with verified author information:

- final author list and order;
- affiliations;
- corresponding-author email/address;
- ORCID;
- funding;
- competing interests;
- ethics statement if required;
- acknowledgments;
- author-contribution roles.

## Scientific stop rule

No additional simulation is required for initial Oikos submission unless a
current claim/figure contract fails or a specific reviewer-relevant robustness
gap is identified.
